scenes.say: Openhere. Pick an empty space on the map, and design it for the people around it.
Spin the globe and pick a spot. Here, a cleared-out Dollarama in Parkdale, Toronto.
scenes.caption: Pick a real space on the map

scenes.say: An agent asks Qloo about this exact spot: the moods locals rate, the venues they love, the artists they'd pay to see.
scenes.caption: An agent asks Qloo who goes out here

scenes.say: Every answer starts from one point on the map, and the room is sized to the crowd.
scenes.caption: Qloo, from one point on the map

scenes.say: Then it redesigns the real photo. Same walls, same windows. Before, and after.
scenes.caption: Before and after, from the real photo

scenes.say: It books acts the locals already love, small enough to fill the room.
scenes.caption: Booked from what locals love

scenes.say: Every design choice cites the Qloo signal behind it.
scenes.caption: Every choice cites Qloo

scenes.say: Ask a model alone for the same room, and none of its eight picks hold up for this crowd.
scenes.caption: Without Qloo, 0 of 8 hold up

scenes.say: Add a brand, and the room changes. Red Bull and Phoebe Bridgers fans share Fender, Vans and Big Red Machine.
scenes.caption: Brand meets fanbase, measured

scenes.say: It works anywhere. In Chelsea, New York, an empty dining car becomes a neighbourhood café.
scenes.caption: Anywhere on the map

scenes.say: Then walk inside, live, in a world model.
scenes.caption: Walk inside

scenes.say: Openhere. Design the place for the people around it.
